narrative.northStar: The painted flooding ruin, with physical decisions happening in front of the player
narrative.overview: Stage 2 provides independent online movement in raster rooms/corridors with local light/LOS, physical lantern and player-centered camera. Next: physical doors, regional water and one guaranteed refuge.
keyCharacteristics: Elevated top-down 2D with a 2.5D impression and recognizable raster explorers.
Independent real-time movement and nearby object prompts.
Regional water and physical doors that alter paths; one refuge in the first level.
Light-dependent local vision, visible held objects and recipient-filtered state
Stable background, reduced decorative motion, compact transparent native controls and system fonts.

rules.name: Raster world
rules.body: Separate interactive world art into raster assets. Invisible collision, flood-mask and shadow geometry is permitted; no drawn scenery/explorer substitutes.

rules.name: Guaranteed scarce refuge
rules.body: Only 1-2 refuges per level, one in the first. Fully closed dry refuge admits zero water indefinitely while closed. No hidden expiry/pressure failure.

rules.name: Readable private state
rules.body: Display nearby physical interactions and held relic artwork while omitting remote explorer coordinates and exact rival inventory/score.

dos: Keep raster artwork dominant and native controls compact.
Make water visuals agree with authoritative depth and dry sealed refuges.
Animate actual directional movement, carried relics and door progress.
Preserve player numbers, keyboard access, reduced decorative motion and provenance.
Validate the first room visually and the first level with independent online players.
donts: Do not create drawn/procedural scenery or explorer replacements.
Do not restore turn waiting, plan locks or fixed anchor travel as target behavior.
Do not reveal remote player positions or full rival inventories.
Do not invalidate sealed-refuge protection through time, pressure or match ending.
Do not treat historical legacy screenshots/finish verdicts as real-time acceptance.
